title: “Verification team” offers a blue badge
scenario: A DM says your account is eligible for verification because your recent post is trending. The form asks for your login and a photo ID to “reserve your badge.”

answers.A: Complete the form because the platform already knows your account is trending.
answers.B: Check verification options inside the platform’s settings/help center and ignore the DM link.
answers.C: Ask a trusted adult or creator to review the message before sharing any ID.

explanation: Fake verification offers target ambition and status. Identity documents and logins should not move through an unsolicited DM.
proTip: A badge should never cost you control of the account.
